text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho had finally 
arrived.

Mejiro Ryan says that because she lost to 
Mejiro McQueen so many times, pursuing her 
is what allowed her to become this strong.

Meanwhile, Mejiro McQueen declares she 
will go all out for victory against Mejiro 
Ryan, who now carries the presence of a 
fully seasoned competitor.

And—with their fighting spirits ablaze, 
the two headed toward the venue of their 
serious showdown together.
